answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can transact, tied to one persistent identity verified by a slow, costly onboarding check. A Sybil operator who wants many fake identities must fund each one, like planting a field of yarrow in a dune where every seedling needs water and care; the cost scales with the number of sock puppets. If an identity misbehaves, its stake is slashed, so the attacker never reaches the zenith of influence cheaply - each new identity starts at the bottom and must earn trust again through verifiable work.
